tip.ctx.head: Tip
tip.ctx.first_wall.title: Your first wall
tip.ctx.first_wall.text: Enter repeats the last command. Click a wall to edit it, or press Space and type what you need.
tip.ctx.first_selection.title: Something is selected
tip.ctx.first_selection.text: Its properties are on the right. Right-click for commands that fit it, Esc clears the selection.
tip.ctx.first_save.title: Saved
tip.ctx.first_save.text: Ctrl+S saves again at any time. Changes are also kept automatically while you work.
tip.ctx.state_on: Tips at the right moment are on
tip.ctx.state_off: Tips at the right moment are off. Turn them on again with the command “Tips at the right moment” (Space)
seq.unknown: {code} is not a shortcut code. Press Space to search all commands.
seq.unknown_near: {code} is not a shortcut code. Codes starting with {first}: {list}. Press Space to search all commands.
help.ref.title: Commands and keys
help.ref.search: Search a command or a key (WA, Ctrl+Z)
help.ref.empty: Nothing matches. Try the command name or fewer letters.
